limitations: The claim is limited to Q8_0 versus F16 K/V under this frozen two-slot Qwen3.8 chat-serving run, with physical prompt counts 8,141 and 16,149 per slot, 65,536 total context and the recorded host, binary, model, treatment order and workload. It does not establish scaling versus the promoted single-slot run, more than two slots, contexts beyond 16k per slot, broad reasoning, other models, production capacity or deployment readiness.

The OpenAI-compatible response does not echo id_slot. Explicit slot 0/1 assignment is bound by the exact executed runner payload, row-level requested_slot/slot records, parallel=2 process controls and client-interval overlap, rather than by a server-returned slot attestation.

Positive client interval intersection proves two HTTP requests were simultaneously in flight. It does not separately timestamp GPU kernel overlap or quantify parallel efficiency; no such stronger claim is authorized.

The 1,698.5 MiB result is a same-host global memory.used block-start comparison, not per-process memory attribution. Batch output rate includes prompt processing and all client-observed latency across each interval union and is only an internal F16-versus-Q8 comparison in this execution.

Static inspection of the concurrency harness excludes a sequential fake-overlap path: a three-party threading.Barrier is shared by two independently submitted ThreadPoolExecutor workers and the coordinating thread. Each worker records client_started only after all three participants release, and the coordinator waits on both futures only after release. No retry or replacement path exists for a non-overlapping scientific batch.

The raw execution has exactly 24 unique batch IDs and 48 unique block/case keys and response IDs. Every batch joins to exactly two sample rows with row slot and requested_slot exactly [0,1]. Independent reconstruction from client_started/client_ended reproduces every recorded overlap flag, overlap_ms, union_wall_ms, slots_requested and aggregate_output_rate without discrepancy; no duplicate, missing or unmatched batch/sample ID was found.

All 24 batches have strictly positive physical client-interval overlap. Recomputed intersections range from 13,488.2701 to 25,046.9362 ms, maximum worker start skew is 0.5670 ms, and the minimum overlap-to-union fraction is 0.80984. This robustly excludes an overlap result created solely by timestamp rounding, while remaining a client-interval concurrency observation rather than a kernel-overlap measurement.
